summary: Worthington Steel filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a $550M asset-based revolving credit agreement to finance the Klöckner Acquisition Transactions. The ABL Facility can be increased up to $750M. It refinances a prior credit agreement. The facility is secured by substantially all assets, with an intercreditor agreement governing priority. Interest rates are based on base rate or SOFR plus margins. The filing specifies the borrowing capacity and use of proceeds for the acquisition. The registrant is the borrower/acquirer. Watch for close of Klöckner acquisition and regulatory approvals.
